subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “On the bus home, Mr. Lee said, 'Technology is useful, but old skills are still tools.”?
options: The best design listens to the people who use it every day.
Every Mother's Day after that, someone asked, "Did you check the sugar"
A list, checked carefully every day, can protect someone when they are too tired to protect themselves.
A tool is not useless just because you do not use it every day."

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The best design listens to the people who use it every day.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Every Mother's Day after that, someone asked, 'Did you check the sugar'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A list, checked carefully every day, can protect someone when they are too tired to protect themselves.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「On the bus home, Mr. Lee said, 'Technology is useful, but old skills are still tools. A tool is not useless just…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「On the bus home, Mr. Lee said, 'Technology is useful, but old skills are still tools. A tool is not useless just because you…」，答案為「A tool is not useless just because you do not use it every day.'」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A tool is not useless just because you do not use it every day.'」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
